notes: Retrospective of SP-tm4wlsve: the orchestrator's hand git -C WORKTREE commit of an answered item file was refused by a permission rule (its message named a forge and a push), and land, started beside it, stopped at step branch on the uncommitted file (ops land.end exit=1 for ST-t2j24bhx). At SP-j2jn5ue4 a hand commit of four --confirm answers was refused by the commit-msg hook twice (it named the review story, then space-separated ids) before the comma-separated list passed. Merged at the 2026-10-12 draft triage from ST-62ixsksb, ST-eiyr4loh and ST-2n3xjhae. Premise: answer --record commits only for --answer, and bl_items.py:290 rejects --confirm with --record; the hand commit there of the item file (skills/sprint/SKILL.md:52) is outside the allow rules (.claude/settings.json:63-67). Planned at the 2026-10-12 draft triage (sprint 16 of 19, "Land snags: gate answers committed by the tool, link touches, stale-touch reads, generated coverage files and the undelivered warning"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates. Premise run 2026-10-12: answer SP-q5ldd25k start --confirm --record --by operator exits 2 (--record keeps the operator's answer as a decision: never --provisional or --confirm); answer --help lists no --commit, so a --confirm answer is never committed by the tool.
